text:
Maya (AE): AlphaCare wants to stand up a short-term POC next week focused on throughput + cost. They need: a billing project seeded with trial credits, a service account or ephemeral key flow for engineers, a hard spend cap, and notes about Dedicated/VPC if we go that route later. Can we outline next steps?

Arjun (SE): We should start hosted to get telemetry quickly. I can create a billing project and issue ephemeral keys scoped to the POC team. For higher-volume tests we can bump quotas or move to Dedicated.

Maya (AE): Customer asked if we can issue a reusable service account instead of ephemeral keys for their infra automation. Security prefers ephemeral keys but will accept a short-lived service account with rotation.

Kevin (Infra): For a reusable service account we need to see their rotation plan and how they'll store credentials (KMS/HSM). Also if they want VPC peering in phase 2, collect: customer CIDR, preferred region, and single IP allowlist for peering test.

Sophie - Finance: Finance can seed up to $3,000 in trial credits for a proof-of-concept. For any request over $7,500 we require a signed SOW. All POC projects should have SpendShield hard caps enabled by default.

Maya (AE): Noted. I'll ask AlphaCare to accept $3k trial and confirm infra contact. Who needs to approve the service account vs ephemeral key decision?

Arjun (SE): SE + Security to approve. If they insist on a long-lived key we require a service account with scoped permissions (read-only for models + generate tokens) and an automated rotation schedule. I can draft the minimal IAM policy.

Kevin (Infra): Dedicated scheduling note: lead time for reserving GPUs is ~12 business days once we have GPU type (A100/H100), expected peak RPS, avg seq len, and streaming percentage. If they want on-prem or VPC earlier, that'll add networking review time.

Maya (AE): AlphaCare's timeline: kickoff Mon 03/28, run for two weeks, then decide. I'll ask for those perf numbers now.

Sophie - Finance: Please create the billing project name convention as: org-alpha-poc-<shortname>. Finance will add the $3k seed once Sales confirms the project id. We will enable hard cap = $3k and alert threshold = $2.4k unless they request otherwise.

Arjun (SE): CLI I'll run once approved (example):
```
redwoodctl projects create --org "alpha-care" --name "org-alpha-poc-acare" --quota-tokens 75000
redwoodctl billing set-spend-cap --project org-alpha-poc-acare --hard-cap-usd 3000 --alert-usd 2400
redwoodctl keys create --project org-alpha-poc-acare --type ephemeral --ttl 12h --note "ACare POC dev keys"
```

Arjun (SE): If Sales wants a service account I will instead run:
```
redwoodctl service-accounts create --project org-alpha-poc-acare --name acare-poc-sa --roles generation,logs.read --rotation 24h
```

Maya (AE): I'll loop in legal for SOW prep and tag Security for the key policy review. Customer contact is laura@alphacare.health — infra contact is pending.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: POC-7712 "AlphaCare POC — billing project + keys" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/POC-7712

Sophie - Finance: Added note to ticket: finance will seed $3k and enforce SpendShield. If they later want top-up auto-pay, procurement details required.

Kevin (Infra): Once project id exists I will share the VPC peering checklist and a template for customer firewall rules.

Arjun (SE): Will wait for Sales approval and project id then I'll provision and paste the project id + ephemeral key in the secure ticket channel (keys posted only to secure channel). :thumbsup:

Maya (AE): Thanks all — I'll update the ticket after customer confirms infra contact and signs the POC agreement.
